sources.name: SFA Track Records current standard query
sources.query: GET with postalCode, establishmentAddress, licenceNumber, businessName, licenseeName, typeOfFoodBussiness, grades blank and isShowLicenceSuspended=false, matching current official frontend query shape
sources.comparison_to_2026_10_18_full_snapshot: Byte-identical response to sfa_track_records_update_proposal_20261018.json source_response_sha256 3e707eea42d8f694a2c887b5021697df4a83bb40650601313475c0bbecc56766; no new current-result-set delta.

sources.name: SFA Track Records past-year suspension filter
sources.query: Same fields blank; isShowLicenceSuspended=true. The official page labels this control “Licence Suspended in the past 1 year”.
sources.filter_label: Licence Suspended in the past 1 year

limits_and_interpretation: SFA Track Records provides current business name, establishment address, food-business type, and grade, but no current licence-validity, cancellation/expiry, permanent-closure, or current-operating-status field.

The 61-result past-year suspension filter is historical track-record information. Its result does not establish that a licence is currently suspended, cancelled, expired, or that an outlet is permanently closed.
All 61 filter results also appear in the standard query result. This reinforces that the filter is a historical track-record flag rather than an active-vs-inactive roster.

The current standard response is byte-identical to the prior 2026-10-18 full result snapshot; the 2024-06-06 SFA open-data location collections remain stale for current status and are not treated as authoritative closure data.
SFA records do not verify general-public access or that an establishment remains open today. Operator/mall evidence or direct verification is still required.
No workbook edits were made. No row should be removed or marked currently suspended from this SFA endpoint alone.
